about: Lumbridge Castle's NPCs: inside the outer wall (the keep, its floors, the towers and courtyard) and the three just outside the gate. Tiles are RSMod's Lumbridge spawn data (rev 233); 2004Scape's RS2 map (m50_50) agrees where marked. Types are the 241 cache's gameval names; Perdu, the banker and the Doomsayer are multi-NPCs and the client shows the form their varbit picks. Wander 5 is RS2's default (2004Scape) for NPCs with no setting of their own; every wander range is guessed until recorded. Left out: Sigmund (hidden once The Lost Tribe is done, which every account has), Aris (only during Recipe for Disaster), the Deadman guards (Deadman worlds only) and the cellar spiders (cellar combat is out of scope).
